document_evidence.chunk_text: piston. - System hot: Unloading device missing -> Install unloader. Insufficient cooling -> Install heat exchanger. - Bearing failure: Misalignment -> Re-align. Foreign matter -> Clean oil. Motor end play -> Eliminate thrust. Speed > 1800 rpm -> Reduce speed. HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS: - Excessive wear: Abrasive matter in oil -> Install filter / replace oil. Viscosity too low -> Use correct oil grade. Sustained high pressure -> Reduce pressure to minimum requirement. Drive misalignment -> Correct alignment. Air recirculation -> Remove air from system.

Hydraulics Troubleshooting Guide Table of Contents Condensed Table - Causes of Trouble and Their Effects in Hydraulic Installations Valves Cylinders Boosters Fluid Motors Vane Pumps Radial Piston Pumps Hydraulic Systems Condensed Table - Causes of Trouble and Their Effects in Hydraulic Installations: 1. Mechanical Drive: - Excessive Noises: coupling wrongly aligned, coupling loose, coupling defective, loose mounting on pump/motor defective, transmission elements loose, pump/motor defective, wrong direction of rotation. - Insufficient Power and Torque: power transmission defective, V-belt or toothed belt slipping, direction of rotation wrong, motor defective, key sheared off at pump/motor. - Jerky Cylinder/Motor Movements: mechanical drive defects, control system defective, installation not bled completely. - Power Take-off Slow/Stops: power take-off blocked (piston seizure), electrical open circuit, limit switches defective. 2. Suction Line: - Suction filter clogged/too small, suction line blocked or leaking, line has wrong dimensions (too many bends), fluid level too low. - Causes cavitation, excessive noises, foaming of fluid. 3. Pump: - Turning too fast, max pump pressure exceeded, shaft seals defective, internal leakage due to wear, pump defective. - System excessively hot, bearing failure, leakage at oil seal, lack of volume. 4. Pressure Line: - Line mountings missing/loose, lines wrongly laid, ID too small, excessive line resistance, pressure filter blocked.

response sluggish: Dirt in system -> Drain and flush system. Restricted drain -> Small fittings or pipe. Pilot pressure low -> Check pilot pressure system. Solenoid malfunction -> Check source voltage/frequency. Distortion of valve body -> Align body and piping. - Valve spool fails to move: Dirt in system -> Disassemble, clean, flush. Blocked drain -> Inspect for plugs/foreign matter. Pilot pressure off -> Check source of pilot pressure. Solenoid inoperative -> Check electrical source. Distortion -> Align body and piping. Improper re-assembly -> Use parts drawing to check proper assembly. - Valve produces undesired response: Improper installation connections -> Check installation drawings. Improper assembly -> Check parts/drawings. Spool installed backwards -> Reverse spool end for end. CYLINDERS: - Erratic action: Valves sticking/binding -> Check dirt, gummy deposit, oil contamination, air, worn parts. Cylinder sticking/binding -> Check dirt, misalignment, worn parts, defective packing. Sluggish operation during warm-up -> Oil viscosity too high at starting temp; use lower viscosity oil or immersion heater. Pilot control pressure too low -> Control line too small or metering choke valve faulty. Internal leakage in cylinder -> Repair/replace worn parts/loose packing. Air in system -> Bleed air, check intake level, check pump packing and intake line connections.
